perception.calibration_notes: Uncalibrated stress-test parameters; not field estimates

randomization.rationale: Narrow engineering sensitivity ranges; not empirical uncertainty bounds

specification.objective: Reference: minimize accumulated entity delay; not an optimized reward

fairness.limitation: Queue wait plus excess downstream hold; unfinished waits are right-censored. Nominal travel/crossing time is excluded.
